meta.json_run_notes: Batch limited to 4 high-confidence nationwide/multi-jurisdictional nonprofit organizations with direct whistleblower assistance pathways (legal, peer support, advocacy). Focused on verified homepages and public mission statements. Excluded government channels, single-state entities, and low-confidence records. Private sector and federal coverage noted where supported; emphasis on retaliation and pre/post-report help for the two personas. Some fields omitted per schema when not confidently verifiable from sources.

records.general_description: Whistleblowers of America is a nonprofit organization assisting whistleblowers who have suffered retaliation after identifying harm to individuals or the public. It provides peer-to-peer support to overcome traumatic stress caused by retaliation, problem-solving assistance, and tools to document retaliation impacts. The organization also engages in legislative advocacy, training on retaliation prevention, and public education to foster environments where truth-telling is protected.
records.whistleblower_note: "WoA is a nonprofit organization assisting whistleblowers who have suffered retaliation after having identified harm to individuals or the public."
records._review_notes: researcher had no notes on current record. Strong post-retaliation peer support focus suitable for James; limited pre-report detail for Maya. Nationwide intent implied by national contact and mission but no explicit quote found.

records.general_description: Government Accountability Project is a non-partisan public interest group founded in 1977 that promotes corporate and government accountability by protecting whistleblowers, advancing occupational free speech, and empowering citizen activists. It provides legal representation, investigations, litigation support, and advocacy for whistleblowers disclosing wrongdoing in government and corporate settings. The organization helps at every step, including pre-disclosure planning, post-report protection from retaliation, and broader campaigns for stronger whistleblower laws.
records.whistleblower_note: "We promote corporate and government accountability by protecting whistleblowers, advancing occupational free speech, and empowering citizen activists."
records._review_notes: researcher had no notes on current record. Serves both government and private sector; intake form available. Strong fit for both personas across stages.

records.general_description: The National Whistleblower Center is a leading nonprofit dedicated to protecting and rewarding whistleblowers around the world while fighting corruption and safeguarding people and the environment. It assists whistleblowers by providing resources, education, advocacy for stronger protections, and connections to legal aid through its attorney referral program. The organization educates the public on whistleblower rights and supports enforcement of laws that encourage disclosures of fraud, waste, abuse, and dangers to public health and safety.
records.whistleblower_note: NWC works with whistleblowers to fight corruption and protect people and the environment; assists in finding legal aid and advocates for stronger whistleblower protection laws.
records._review_notes: researcher had no notes on current record. Focus on education, referral, and advocacy; attorney referral program noted but details limited in homepage scrape. Suitable nationwide resource for both personas.

records.general_description: Whistleblower Aid is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting and protecting whistleblowers in the interest of the public. It provides pro bono legal advice, advocacy, and communications support to government and private sector whistleblowers reporting misconduct and lawbreaking safely and lawfully. The organization helps whistleblowers navigate disclosures while minimizing personal risks, including retaliation.
records.whistleblower_note: Whistleblower Aid is a legal non-profit that helps government and private sector whistleblowers report misconduct and lawbreaking safely and lawfully.
